modelspec.diagram.GlyphId.title: GlyphId
modelspec.diagram.GlyphId.description: The id of one SVG symbol of the glyph set (DESIGN.md § 13.1). `op-<operator>` for each Tensor IR operation, the operator in kebab case (`op-mat-mul`, `op-layer-norm-grad-x`), an Input also `op-input-token` for a dropout RNG token and `op-input-step` for a host input of an AdamW step; `scope-<kind>` for a composite of a Function, Adjoint, Module or Layer scope and `scope-update-<optimizer>` for an Update scope; `stage-<stage>` for a pipeline stage; `endpoint-<role>` for an endpoint. Every TensorOp variant has exactly one, and a gradient op's glyph is its forward operator's with the gradient mark.
